versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Marketing Automation skill.
- Enables full marketing operations via API: manage prospects, campaigns, outreach, solutions, and costs.
- Designed for AI agents with programmatic access — no manual dashboards required.
- Enforces x402 authentication and cost per endpoint (USDC on Base).
- Comprehensive endpoint coverage: create/research prospects, launch campaigns, track outreach and spend, manage solution catalog, and log conversations.
